resources.string: The server may have applied this note change, but confirmation could not be saved. Your local text and photos are retained. This change and later changes on this note will not be repeated automatically. Check the note history before resolving or discarding it.
Resolution failed. The note was not safely resolved. Check the selected note and try again.
I checked this existing note. Link it without creating a new note:
Delete this pending local change and its local photos? The server may already have applied it. This does not change any OSM note.

The server acknowledged this change. Synchronize to finish local processing. If the note is missing or hidden, you can explicitly discard this local edit after checking its history; no new request will be sent.

Matching author, text and time does not identify which local comment or close succeeded. Keep this edit, or explicitly discard it after checking the note history. No automatic retry or automatic matching is performed.
The acknowledged note is unavailable (missing or no longer accessible). Your local data is retained until you explicitly resolve it.
The server reports this note as hidden (HTTP 410). Your local data is retained until you explicitly resolve it.
The note could not be checked because of a connection error. Local data is unchanged. Try again later.
This edit changed or has dependent changes. Reopen it and review subsequent edits before discarding a new note.
The server rejected this note change. Local text and photos are retained. Check the note and correct or explicitly discard the pending edit.
